$comment: The session steps each gated action needs (ADR-0010). steps.mjs reads this file; the order lives only here. scope: "all-worktrees" checks every worktree of the repository, else ("tree") only --tree or the hook's own tree. A step is "check" (the yotamake-check-passed stamp scripts/check writes) or the name of a review skill (a review event for that exact skill). afterLastEdit: steps that must come after the last edit; edits is "code" (docs do not count) or "any"; sameSession counts only this session's edits; mainOnly leaves out edits a subagent made (agent_id set), which the commit gate still counts. inReviewWindow: steps that must come after the first code edit of the review window, waived by the skips in skipWhen ("docs-only": every file the branch changes against the main branch is a doc; "trailer": the commit message has a Review-skipped: line).
